events.continuity_hook: Starts a new industry conference episode after the Palm Springs personal weekend is booked.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight-and-hotel shortlist that protects the booth setup window, compares Louisville versus Cincinnati access, and keeps the demo-case delivery question visible.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah is asked to cover a membrane-track booth and a distributor breakfast at a regional water conference in Louisville. Booth setup is listed for Sunday afternoon and his first scheduled commitment is Monday morning, so he needs Bay Area flight options into Louisville that arrive with enough time for convention check-in and avoid awkward multi-stop routing; Cincinnati is only worth comparing if the schedule or fare is clearly better. Hotel options need to compare the official convention block with better-rated nearby downtown hotels, easy dinner access, and practical room basics for early starts. The open item is whether the tabletop demo case can ship to the show decorator or needs hotel receiving.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Louisville conference planning after the setup window moves earlier and makes a Saturday arrival more practical.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the safer arrival day, narrow the airport plan, and decide which downtown hotel trade-off is the best fit while waiting on demo-case instructions.
events.scenario_brief: The conference organizer moves Jonah’s booth access to Sunday morning, and the distributor adds a late-afternoon Sunday walkthrough before the Monday breakfast. Sunday travel no longer leaves enough cushion, so he needs to compare Saturday afternoon Bay Area departures into Louisville with one workable connection against a cheaper Cincinnati option that adds a rental-car drive. The hotel choice has narrowed to the official block closest to the convention center versus a better-reviewed riverfront property with more reliable restaurant options; the demo-case receiving plan is still not confirmed.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Louisville conference plan from comparison to booking once the shipping question is resolved.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, hotel, room notes, seat request, and concise conference itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The show decorator confirms direct delivery for the tabletop demo case, so Jonah no longer needs the hotel to receive equipment. He settles on a Saturday afternoon Bay Area departure into Louisville with one manageable connection, a Wednesday evening return after booth teardown, and the better-rated downtown hotel that is still walkable to the convention center and restaurants. He wants the room notes to request a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and he wants a window seat selected where available.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a drive-to client-site hotel episode after the Louisville conference booking is settled.
events.interaction_goal: Shortlist practical hotels for the plant visit and show the trade-off between restaurant access in Visalia and a shorter early drive from Tulare.
events.scenario_brief: A food-and-beverage plant outside Visalia asks Jonah to observe a filtration skid during an early Tuesday sanitation changeover and a mid-morning vendor review. He plans to drive from the Bay Area rather than fly, so the search is focused on Monday-night hotel options in Visalia or Tulare with strong guest feedback, parking, reliable early-morning departure logistics, and quick dinner nearby. The unresolved item is whether Tuesday data collection will require a Wednesday morning follow-up, which would add a second hotel night.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Visalia-area plant visit after the possible second night becomes required.
events.interaction_goal: Book the two-night hotel stay, capture the early-departure room notes, and summarize the drive-and-site schedule without adding flights or a rental car.
events.scenario_brief: The plant manager confirms a Wednesday morning troubleshooting session, so Jonah now needs two nights instead of one. He chooses the Tulare-area hotel because it shortens the pre-dawn plant drive, still has solid customer ratings, parking, and enough nearby dinner choices. He wants a flexible two-night booking, a room request for a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and a note that he may leave the hotel very early both mornings.

events.continuity_hook: Adds a brief site-access check to the already booked Visalia-area plant visit.
events.interaction_goal: Update the itinerary with the new gate, parking lot, and check-in time, and verify the practical hotel notes for the early mornings.
events.scenario_brief: The plant safety coordinator sends final visitor instructions with a different wastewater gate, a specific contractor parking lot, and a check-in time earlier than the original Tuesday plan. Jonah does not want to reopen the hotel search; he only needs the itinerary notes updated, the hotel parking and early departure details rechecked, and the room amenity request carried through on the reservation.
